title: The Protocol of the Free Port
author: Silas Galloway
blurb: Freya Yarrow, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
